item.title: Highstreet Acquires Minnesota-Baesd Player’s Health
item.description: Highstreet Insurance Partners has acquired the retail insurance brokerage business of Player’s Health, a specialized agency serving organizations and businesses across the sports and fitness industries. Minneapolis, Minnesota-based Player’s Health has built its reputation around understanding the unique risks facing sports organizations and fitness businesses. The new practice will build on Player’s Health’s established presence in the sports community and the leadership of its founder and CEO, Tyrre Burks, who will continue to lead the business beginning December 1, 2026.

item.title: Burns & Wilcox Acquires Louisiana’s Mercury Underwriters
item.description: Burns & Wilcox has acquired Mercury Underwriters, a New Orleans-based property and casualty Managing General Agency (MGA) and broker. The transaction follows the Burns & Wilcox acquisition in May of Mercury Underwriters’ Garage book and completes the transition of Mercury’s business to Burns & Wilcox. Mercury will be absorbed into the Burns & Wilcox New Orleans team, which will provide Mercury’s agency partners with continuity of service, relationships and carrier partnerships.

item.title: P&C soft market deepens, but profitability cushion will gradually erode: Swiss Re
item.description: But competition is driving prices down even as risks become more complex and this is likely to continue, until the profitability cushion gets eroded over time, the reinsurer explained. item.title: AI-driven data centre expansion reshaping both sides of insurers’ balance sheets: Morningstar DBRS
item.description: “While most insurers approach the segment with relative caution, and there is no current evidence of overconcentration, we consider the impact on credit profiles with a focus on aggregate exposure, applicable policy limits, reinsurance protection, and capital resilience.” Patrick Douville, Vice President, Global Insurance & Pension Ratings, Morningstar DBRS, said, “AI-driven data centre expansion is reshaping both sides of insurers’ balance sheets, creating opportunities to underwrite and finance a rapidly growing asset class while also introducing new forms of concentration risk. Morningstar DBRS has suggested that the rapid expansion of AI-driven data centres is reshaping both sides of insurers’ balance sheets, creating opportunities to underwrite and finance a fast-growing asset class while introducing new forms of concentration risk. Morningstar DBRS described the global push to develop large-scale data centres to support AI as a significant opportunity for the insurance industry, creating growing demand for coverage of both the projects themselves and their associated infrastructure assets, as well as financing solutions.

item.title: Oneglobal and Asiste enter partnership to strengthen re/insurance services in Peru
item.description: Asiste Corredores de Seguros, an independent Peruvian insurance broker, has entered into a strategic partnership with international reinsurance intermediary Oneglobal Corredores de Reaseguros S.A., seeking to improve access to specialist risk solutions and overseas insurance capacity for businesses operating in Peru. Asiste will provide local market knowledge and established client relationships, while Oneglobal will contribute its technical resources and connections across global insurance and reinsurance markets. The alliance with Asiste lets us combine these capabilities with a deep knowledge of the Peruvian market.” Asiste and Oneglobal have identified infrastructure, engineering, transport logistics, aviation, marine insurance and agribusiness among the areas where they anticipate potential business opportunities.

item.title: The Fidelis Partnership appoints Lindsay Chi as Head of High Growth Markets
item.description: The Fidelis Partnership (TFP), a privately owned managing general underwriter (MGU) based in Bermuda, has appointed Lindsay Chi as Head of High Growth Markets (HGM). John-Paul O’Hare, Group Director of Underwriting, The Fidelis Partnership, commented, “We’re pleased to be appointing Lindsay as Head of High Growth Markets after two successful years with TFP and we are looking forward to working with her in these markets as we drive the firm’s growth outside traditionally served insurance and reinsurance markets.” Chi added, “I’m delighted to be stepping into this new role to lead the High Growth Markets strategy across TFP, supporting the company’s growth and expansion into underserved markets.” According to a recent Allianz 2026 Global Insurance Report, The Future of Insurance in a Fragmenting World, P&C insurance premium in high-growth markets is expected to grow from approximately $526 billion in 2025 to approximately $1.1 trillion in 2036.

item.title: Slice brings its MGA into brokers’ own AI assistants with new MCP integration
item.description: The post Slice brings its MGA into brokers’ own AI assistants with new MCP integration appeared first on Insurtech Insights . item.title: Holmes Murphy launches workers’ comp claims tool
item.description: Holmes Murphy has launched an AI-powered claims benchmarking tool within its proprietary CLUE (Client Learning & Understanding Engine) platform, allowing employers to compare workers’ compensation claims against tens of millions of anonymized claims nationwide. For open claims, predictive benchmarks help assess how a claim is tracking against comparable claims at the same stage of development, forecast potential future severity, and flag outliers early, so our Claims team can identify opportunities to intervene before costs escalate.” – Jeffrey Austin White, chief data and analytics officer at Holmes Murphy. For open claims, the tool compares progress with similar claims at the same stage, forecasts potential severity and flags outliers that may warrant intervention.

item.title: In The AI Era, Keep Hiring New College Grads — And Make Them Managers From Day One
item.description: College graduates typically do the individual contributor knowledge work that AI is evermore capable of delivering. And how will we develop the generation of managers who will supervise AI? Our claim is that the reason senior folks get more out of AI today is not primarily because they have greater subject knowledge, but rather because they are good managers.

item.title: Texas Farm Bureau aims to upsize Fish Pond Re 2026-1 cat bond 60% to $400m
item.description: Texas Farm Bureau Insurance Companies is looking to meaningfully upsize its second catastrophe bond sponsorship, with the target increased 60% to now seek $400 million of named storm reinsurance from this Fish Pond Re Ltd. Initially for this renewal, the Texas Farm Bureau Insurance Companies returned to the catastrophe bond market for its second sponsorship seeking $250 million of named storm reinsurance, from this Series 2026-1 issuance of notes by Fish Pond Re . Texas Farm Bureau Insurance returned to the catastrophe bond market for the second time at the start of the month, with a new Fish Pond Re issuance that looks set to be a renewal of its soon to mature debut cat bond deal.

item.title: VKB secures upsized €200m King Max Re cat bond renewal priced below guidance
item.description: VKB, the German domestic market insurance group, has successfully finalised its latest catastrophe bond sponsorship, securing the upsized target of €200 million of German multi-peril reinsurance protection from the King Max Re II DAC (Series 2026-1) issuance, while the notes have now been priced below the initial guidance, this publication understands. Versicherungskammer Bayern Versicherungsanstalt des oeffentlichen Rechts’ (VKB) ventured back to the catastrophe bond market in October to sponsor its second issuance, with this Series 2026-1 a renewal of sorts for the company’s soon to mature debut cat bond, the €175 million King Max Re 2023 , which matures in early January 2027. We’re now told that the targeted upsizing has been secured, as investor demand helped VKB secure more reinsurance than initially sought, while the pricing was finalised at a level below the initial guidance range indicating strong execution for the cat bond sponsor.

item.title: New California legal opinion sets guardrails for parametric insurance deployment: Ceres
item.description: Ceres, a US-based non-profit organisation that leads a national coalition of investors, environmental organisations and other public interest groups working to address global sustainability challenges, has welcomed a new General Counsel opinion letter from the California Department of Insurance clarifying how parametric insurance can be effectively deployed across the state’s admitted market. According to Ceres, the legal opinion is expected to clear a path for wider parametric adoption across California, helping to close protection gaps caused by increasingly frequent extreme weather. The California Department of Insurance has since supported a community-based parametric flood insurance pilot in Isleton, a coastal resilience and insurance effort in Imperial Beach, extreme heat coverage for Los Angeles’ street vendors, and research into insuring urban forests,” Ceres added.

item.title: ICA reports 4,670 claims from severe storms in Queensland and NSW
item.description: The Insurance Council of Australia (ICA) has reported that insurers have now received 4,670 claims from the severe storms that have impacted Queensland and parts of New South Wales since 11 November 2026. Claims for food spoilage are also increasing due to extended power outages, now accounting for around 30% of home claims in Queensland. The Bureau of Meteorology warned that severe thunderstorms were likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall, potentially leading to flash flooding across a large part of Queensland.

item.title: Insurance leaders call for collective approach to climate resilience at COP31
item.description: At COP31 in Türkiye, the Global Sustainable Insurance Summit examined how the insurance sector can help reduce climate risks, strengthen economic resilience and finance the sustainable transition. Organised by the Insurance Association of Türkiye (TSB) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) at the COP31 Insurance House, the Summit brought together executives and specialists from across the re/insurance and resilience sectors. TSB Secretary General Özgür Obalı opened the Summit by stressing that climate resilience is a collective challenge requiring cooperation between the public and private sectors.

item.title: AM Best places Canopius ratings under review with positive implications following Samsung acquisition deal
item.description: and Canopius Reinsurance Limited under review with positive implications after Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance (SFM) announced plans to take majority ownership of Canopius Group Limited. AM Best, the global credit rating agency focused on the insurance sector, has placed the ratings of Canopius US Insurance, Inc. AM Best’s decision follows the 10 November 2026 announcement of an agreement under which SFM, together with investment firm KKR and Korea Investment Corporation (KIC), will purchase the 60% of Canopius currently owned by Centerbridge Partners.

item.title: Data Center Investors Underestimate Climate Risk, Report Says
item.description: The fallout of climate change may expose the world’s data centers to losses that investors aren’t currently pricing in, according to a report published on Oct. Most of the risk, or 61%, is to IT equipment, rather than buildings housing data centers, the Jupiter Intelligence report found, adding that such climate impacts are currently largely uninsured. A study earlier this year of roughly 2,600 planned data centers worldwide indicated that more than 150 will be built on sites facing a high physical climate risk, with key hazards including coastal inundation, high heat and riverine flooding.

item.title: Nvidia Scandal Raises New Concerns About Scale of Chinese Spying
item.description: The revelation that Nvidia Corp.’s now ex-CEO had an affair with a woman suspected of spying for China has rocked the US artificial intelligence boom and thrust allegations that Beijing is seeking to infiltrate Western tech giants into public view. Canadian intelligence calls China its “greatest counter-intelligence threat ,” while Dutch intelligence says Chinese digital espionage against technology companies is happening on a “large scale.” Beijing has dismissed the Huang espionage allegations as a smear, accusing Washington of fabricating “Chinese spy narratives” to justify restrictions on technology exports. Despite those denials, the suspected spy at the center of the scandal that toppled Huang is now in China with the knowledge of the Chinese government.

item.title: Democrat Holscher Wins Kansas Governor’s Race Amid Data Center Backlash
item.description: Democrat Cindy Holscher, who campaigned on a moratorium for data-center development, won the Kansas governor’s race as the tech backlash reverberated in one of the country’s most conservative states. Holscher made data centers a central issue in her campaign, linking local anger over AI and its infrastructure to energy affordability and popular backlash against big tech. “It’s the honor of a lifetime to serve as your next Governor,” she wrote on X following the race call Thursday night.

item.title: Swiss Re appoints Lori Goltermann as Chief Commercial Officer, Corporate Solutions
item.description: The post Swiss Re appoints Lori Goltermann as Chief Commercial Officer, Corporate Solutions appeared first on Insurtech Insights . Swiss Re has appointed Lori Goltermann as Chief Commercial Officer for Corporate Solutions, a newly created global role in its commercial insurance business. The appointment of a Chief Commercial Officer creates a new global role within Corporate Solutions, with Goltermann starting in January 2027.

item.title: Definity launches Guidewire-powered AI assistant for brokers in Vyne
item.description: Definity Financial Corporation has launched Definity Assist, an AI-powered assistant for brokers built on Guidewire ProNavigator, within its Vyne digital broker platform. Definity Assist lets brokers ask questions in plain language and receive answers within the Vyne screens where they work. "Giving them instant access to trusted, accurate answers within Vyne empowers them to make better decisions, uncover new opportunities, and deliver a level of service that sets them and Definity apart." "AI delivers the most value when it's embedded directly into the tools people use every day," said Joseph D'Souza, General Manager, ProNavigator at Guidewire.
